purpose: test whether newly launched U-settled BTC and ETH perpetuals have a persistent static funding differential versus matched USDT perpetuals without forecasting market direction

source_boundary.fee_snapshot_provenance: indexed verbatim snapshot labeled Source Binance EN; exact Binance detail URL was not recovered and is not assumed
source_boundary.launch_semantics: BTCU and ETHU are perpetual contracts settled in U with eight-hour funding
source_boundary.current_public_fee_semantics: U-margined perpetual maker fee zero and regular-to-VIP3 taker fee 0.04 percent until further notice

request_contract.raw_persistence: atomically rewrite a canonical journal after every successful response before parsing or evaluation
request_contract.one_shot_rule: do not rerun reorder paginate or change gates after the first funding response

public_persistence_candidate_requires: training net after frozen execution and capital hurdles positive
validation net after frozen execution and capital hurdles positive
test net after frozen execution and capital hurdles positive
each chronological half inside validation and test gross positive
worst cumulative drawdown no greater than 50 bips
at least 60 percent positive settlements in validation and test
accepted_edge_requires_additionally: same-account regional U and Futures eligibility
exact account USDT and U contract commissions
synchronized executable entry and exit depth
U settlement conversion spreads and depeg stress
collateral haircuts margin liquidation and capital reconciliation
bull bear sideways choppy volatility liquidity and latency slices

prohibited_shortcuts: treating the U and USDT marks as identical settlement cash
zeroing U depeg conversion collateral or liquidation risk
reusing the terminal USDT versus USDC history
calling a short newly launched history stable or deployment-ready
